about: GTA 6 scored 99 on Metacritic (PS5 page: Metascore 99, Universal acclaim; JSON-LD reviewCount 156, hero block 150; Xbox Series X 99 from 14), tying The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998, N64, Metascore 99 from 22 critics) at the top of Metacritic's all-time game list. All-time list (read 2026-11-19 07:20 UTC): GTA VI 99, Ocarina of Time 99, SoulCalibur 98, Super Mario Galaxy 2 98, GTA IV 98, Super Mario Galaxy 97, GTA V 97. Sources in BRIEF.md.

lines.say: G T A six scored ninety-nine.

lines.text: That ties the best Metacritic score ever.
But it's not alone. One other game has 99.
lines.say: But it's not alone. One other game has ninety-nine.
Zelda, Ocarina of Time. From nineteen ninety-eight.
Its ninety-nine came from twenty-two critics.
G T A six got it from about a hundred and fifty.
G T A four at ninety-eight. G T A five at ninety-seven.

lines.text: Three GTA games in the top seven.
lines.say: Three G T A games in the top seven.

lines.text: Does GTA 6 deserve the 99? Yes or no?
